record.body:
## Description

Re-review findings:

1. `tests/test_orchestra_callers.py::_claim_acceptance` still puts the claim id only in the subject; after R1 removed the fallback, its R6/R7/R9 test closes no longer gate. Update the fixture to `payload.claim`.
2. `_enforce_claim_gates` loads acceptances even when `.affidavit/manifest.json` is absent, so a plain manual done close now refuses (`tests/test_verify_authority.py::test_close_batch_still_creates_manual_check_runs`). Restore the no-manifest early exit; R8 still refuses once a manifest exists.
3. `tests/test_close_batch.py` R5/R6/R1 assertions use `... or CLAIM_ID in msg`, which is vacuous because the message always names the claim id. Assert the clock name directly.

## Approach

Keep the fix from `fix-claim-gate-unit-hook`. Add `"claim": CLAIM_ID` to `_claim_acceptance`. Re-add `if not claim_ids: return` at the top of `_enforce_claim_gates`. Tighten the three msg assertions. Do not edit `tests/test_claim_clocks.py`.

payload.title: Fix claim gate regressions from the phase changes
